Level 1 to 58 guide before starting my Decompose Pathfinder Build
Made with the intent of guiding new players on a fresh league start. Incremental tips as you progress

Make sure to go back and pick up all the permanent buffs throughout the campaign if you missed any.
The transition to the Decompose Build requires some gold, so be sure not to gamble away all of it for when you respec your tree upon reaching level 58.

Frequently Asked Questions
- I can't use my weapon set passive points, why?
You first need normal passive points before you can split them with the weapon set points. So to apply the max 24 weapon points for each set, you first need 24 normal passive points available to use
- How come I can't summon 's each time I swap weapons?
When one of our 's die, it start the minion respawn timer. Normally takes up to 8-11 seconds before they can spawn again. When outside combat, weapon swapping bypasses this timer, and always spawns your minions instantly. When in-combat however, you need to wait for this timer to run out first or use  to resummon them a limited number of extra times
- My minions have a X MINUTE respawn timer?!
This happens due to the game letting you have more minions selected than your spirit allows. Make sure to press the - (minus) button to reduce the amount of minions you have until the + (plus) lights up, and click that once
- Why aren't my 's summoned when I swap to set 2?
First thing to check is the skill gem section of the current variant you are playing. Each skill should only be active on one of the two sets.  requires that you specifically set the amount summoned per set. Put it at the max possible for set 2, and none for set 1. This build revolves around the  skill that gets cast every time you take a step with  boots equipped. It automatically targets dead enemies around you (corpses), consuming them to create poison clouds that slowly expand. It deals pseudo-hit chaos damage poison based on the life of that enemy before it died, meaning it scales with monster HP and level.
 allows  to trigger on our own undead minions (), meaning we can spawn poison clouds without needing to kill something first. Thus  will do more damage the more life the  has.
To spawn 's to create poison clouds when we need them, we use weapon swapping. This way we can have all our de-buffs and buffs active on Set 1, minions and  active on Set 2, thus effectively doubling our usable spirit. So when we swap to Set 2 our minions instantly spawn next to us and  targets them as we step.
Each  targeted by  will spawn it's own poison cloud. Each cloud applies one poison per 2 seconds up to a maximum poison capacity. With , , 2x  and  our maximum poison capacity becomes 10. More poison clouds = more poisons per second, NOT more damage. It just means you reach the poison capacity faster, and stay at max longer.
When one of our 's die, it will start the minion respawn timer. Normally it can take 10-16 seconds before they can spawn naturally again. When outside combat, weapon swapping bypasses this timer, and always spawns your minions instantly. When in-combat however, you usually have to wait, luckily  can ressurrect your minions. You can keep casting it until you don't summon any more minions before swapping back to Set 1.  clouds last long enough that you don't need to resummon minions often anyway.
During maps, we don't want to wait for this timer before we can spawn clouds, so we use  instead for killing packs of monsters. As long as a couple monsters survive,  will target the corpses of stuff we kill and poison those remaining monsters. This refills our  instantly meaning we can use it again for the next pack of monsters. When casting , make sure to hit several packs of monsters, we don't want to kill everything with one cast.  clouds should clean up stragglers.
 will only gather poison when using Set 1. Make sure to stay in Set 1 whenever possible, as our de-buffs such as  with  and  are only active when that set is equipped.
